ارتعبوا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَعَبُوا (irtaʕabū) /ir.ta.ʕa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَعَبَ (irtaʕaba)
# اِرْتَعِبُوا (irtaʕibū) /ir.ta.ʕi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْتَعَبَ (irtaʕaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
